annotation.summary_en: A man explains to his companion why he respects him, emphasizing the importance of knowing when to stop, set against a backdrop of a casino and a boxing ring.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins at the entrance of a building labeled with a large CASINO sign. A doorman dressed in a formal red uniform stands outside the establishment, greeting a woman visitor as she approaches the entrance. The scene then transitions to an indoor setting designed to look like a boxing ring, characterized by red ropes. Here, the tone shifts as two men engage in a conversation. One man is wearing a white tank top, while the other is dressed in a suit but incongruously wears large white boxing gloves. The dialogue revolves around mutual respect and self-control. The man in the tank top tells his companion that he respects him specifically for his ability to 'stop on time' (vaxtin stop tas), a trait he finds admirable. He emphasizes their similarities using a mix of Armenian and Russian phrases like 'Ty i ya takie'. The visual contrast between the formal suit/casino setting and the boxing ring adds a layer of absurdity to the discussion about restraint.
catchphrases: քեզ գիտես ինչի համար եմ հարգում
որ կարում ես վախտին ստոպ տաս
